description: Documents how bot data is structured in the savedFile format

botPresetName.description: List of preset name strings — one per preset slot (4 slots total, only indices 0-2 are used). The app reorders rather than renames: a preset whose stored name is exactly 'Farming' is moved to slot 0 and one named 'Tourney' to slot 1; the rest keep their stored order, and a slot with an empty/missing name falls back to 'Preset N'.
botPresetName.ordering: shared.resolvePresetOrder(botPresetName, ['Farming', 'Tourney']) → { order, indices }. All the per-bot preset lists below are indexed with indices[slot], not with slot.

flameBotPresets.description: List of 4 preset slot objects for Flame Bot. Only indices 0-2 are used. Each object follows the presetStructure schema.

thunderBotPresets.description: List of 4 preset slot objects for Thunder Bot. Only indices 0-2 are used. Each object follows the presetStructure schema.

goldenBotPresets.description: List of 4 preset slot objects for Golden Bot. Only indices 0-2 are used. Each object follows the presetStructure schema.

amplifyBotPresets.description: List of 4 preset slot objects for Amplify Bot. Only indices 0-2 are used. Each object follows the presetStructure schema.

botBotPresets.description: List of 4 preset slot objects for Bot Bot. Only indices 0-2 are used. Each object follows the presetStructure schema.

synchronicityPresets.description: List of 4 preset slot objects for Synchronicity. Only indices 0-2 are used. Each object follows the synchronicityPresets schema.

presetStructure.description: Each botPreset key maps to a list of 4 preset slots. Only indices 0-2 are relevant (index 3 is unused).

presetFields.plusUnlocked: boolean — whether the plus upgrade is unlocked
presetFields.active: boolean — whether this preset is active. NOT the source of the app's 'active' flag; see valueRules.
presetFields.plusLevel: integer — level of the bot's plusUpgrade (single value)
presetFields.unlocked: boolean — whether this preset slot is unlocked
presetFields.levels: array of 4 integers — upgrade levels in the order defined per bot (see below)
presetFields.selectedLevels: array — currently selected upgrade levels (not read by the app)

valueRules.description: How a preset slot becomes the values written to the sheet.
valueRules.upgradeLevels: levels[j] → String(level).padStart(2, '0'); a falsy level becomes '00'.
valueRules.plusUpgrade: 'Lo' when plusUnlocked is false. When plusUnlocked is true: String(plusLevel).padStart(2, '0'), except that a null/undefined/empty plusLevel also becomes 'Lo'.
valueRules.active: taken from the slot's `unlocked` field (null when that field is absent), not from the slot's `active` field.

synchronicityPresets.description: A list of 4 preset slots (indices 0-2 relevant). Each slot has a 'synchronicityBots' array with one entry per bot (5 bots total). Values are null when not assigned.

synchronicityBots.description: array of 5 values — one per bot by index

example.description: Example of what a single flameBotPresets entry looks like
